Frequently Asked Questions We’ve answered the most frequently asked questions What is AI video generation? AI video generation is the process of creating videos using artificial intelligence models. Instead of filming with a physical camera, you describe what you want (through text prompts, reference images, or both) and the AI produces a video clip. Modern AI video tools like Higgsfield go far beyond basic prompt-to-video by giving you control over camera movement, character consistency, optical style, and more. What AI video models are available on Higgsfield? Higgsfield provides access to multiple AI video model families, including Kling, Seedance, Veo, and Wan. Each supports different generation modes, references, durations, and creative controls. Available models and versions depend on your plan and the tool you use. What is Cinema Studio? Cinema Studio is Higgsfield’s workspace for cinematic video creation. It lets you choose camera and lens settings, guide camera movement, and adjust lighting and visual style. It includes a Director’s Panel and supports reusable character, location, and prop references to help maintain consistency across shots. Do I need video editing experience to use Higgsfield? No. Higgsfield is designed to be accessible to beginners while offering advanced controls for professionals. You can start with a simple text prompt and generate a video in minutes. As you get more comfortable, you can explore features like motion control, first/last frame references, and Cinema Studio for more precise results. Can I use my own images or videos as input? Yes. You can upload reference images to guide the style, subject, or composition of your generation. You can also upload existing video footage to edit it, swap styles, change objects, or refine details without reshooting. The first and last frame reference feature lets you lock the start and end points of your video for consistent output. What can I use AI-generated videos for? Higgsfield is used across a wide range of industries: filmmakers and directors use it for pre-visualization and short films, marketing and fashion teams create product ads and campaign videos, content creators produce social media clips at scale, and educators build training and explainer videos. Any use case that requires visual storytelling can benefit from AI video. How is Higgsfield different from other AI video generators? Higgsfield is the generative platform for creative production, combining multiple AI video models and specialized creative tools. Generate videos from text or images, direct cinematic scenes in Cinema Studio, and transform existing footage with Genjutsu. Supported workflows also offer reference-based generation, image animation, motion control, and synchronized audio. What video quality and formats does Higgsfield support? Video resolution, duration, and aspect ratio depend on the selected model and workflow. Options include 720p and 1080p, with selected models supporting generation up to 4K. Supported workflows offer vertical, square, and widescreen aspect ratios, so you can choose a format suited to your project. Is Higgsfield free to use? Yes. Higgsfield has a free plan, and new accounts get 10 free credits once at sign-up. For regular use, see the plans. How much does it cost to generate an AI video on Higgsfield? New accounts get 10 free credits once at sign-up; the cost of a video depends on the model and settings and is shown before you generate. For regular use, see the plans. Can I use AI-generated videos commercially? Yes. Higgsfield's Terms of Use do not restrict commercial use of your generated outputs, including ads, client work, and brand campaigns.
